title: Prove explicit production precision for the direct circulant word, including partial-gate and cache bounds
body:
## A local numerical theorem for the actual #7849 word

This package proves a smaller sufficient fractional precision for the original direct-circulant Fourier computation at #7849, including coefficient synthesis, partial routed gates, cached tensor coefficients and state-relative data rounding. It is a **local analytic interface theorem under named source contracts**, with a separate accepting review. No complete canonical assumption is removed and **no new κ** is claimed.

[Proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/PROOF.md) · [Independent cross-review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md) · [Executed registered replay](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/evidence/registered-replay.txt)

### Exact result

For d≥1 axes with true orders 2≤r_i≤2^ell_i, ell_i≥1, public p≥1 and L=sum ell_i, set:

```text
E = ceil(1257 L / 2) + 2154 d
A = 104 L + 438 d
J = 20000 (d+1) (max ell_i+2)^6
C = 4 J (d+1)^2 + d+1
P = 4p + A + 2E + bit_length(C).
```

Use P in the external Grid and the unchanged P+8 coefficient-construction call. On every represented complete padded input of maximum modulus at most one half, raw coordinate error is strictly below 2^(-4p), for both signs. The ideal transform is the true Fourier mean with identity on local holes. The inherited public-grid recovery theorem still gives integer error at most 144/B^2<1/2 for B≥32, under its CRT character, true-volume, scaling and no-wrap hypotheses.

The new linear term is 4p+1361L+4746d+(L mod 2), compared with the source's 4p+32768(L+6d). At p=72 and axis widths (4,5), the sufficient fractional precision falls from 688,620 to 22,068 bits. This is a selector comparison, not a measured transform speedup, minimum-precision result or memory theorem. The proof also shows the original selector is larger on every supported input, validating its numerical budget under the same contracts.

### What closes the source-specific gap

The rounded circulant root remains strictly accretive on every leading section, giving the actual inverse allowance. Substitution into the retained full compiler estimates yields physical prefix and inverse bounds 2^98 t^52. The literal sixteen-H lowering and routing give 2^537 t^156 per root and 2^1076 t^314 per axis. Prefix and inverse-prefix bounds control arbitrary external intervals; endpoint conditioning alone is insufficient.

A coefficient-cache invariant states that each stored suffix is the rounded expression in the current coordinate factors. Carrying rebuilds exactly the affected suffix. Its error therefore depends on the number of axes, not the number of earlier tensor records. The resulting local defect is at most (d+1)^2 2^(-P+A)(1+norm(z)). Diagonal and H actions are separate mathematical steps, so a pre-H rounding error is propagated. The final selector makes both the bootstrap spend and raw-error bound strict.

The separate reviewer found a harmless prose census ambiguity: fully expanded lowering has 23 diagonals and 16 H factors, hence 38 non-pivot factors. Those two sentences were corrected; 64^40 and every selector constant remain unchanged. The accepted proof hash is 26e4e214f0a5785c1d1414561465bb49a3248f9e6f59f6b514eb95a887bdfe2f. Its original pre-review status line is preserved for hash identity; the later review records acceptance.

### Reproduction and independent evidence

With standard-library CPython 3.12, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-circulant-production-precision
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-circulant-production-precision --check-modes
```

All three registered commands passed in orchestrator execution. Normal and optimized author checks cover 203 exact two-wire words, 2,448 odometer records, 60 allocator bindings and 53 selector inputs. Controls reject source corruption, wrong phases, omitted inverse-prefix reasoning, stale suffixes, missing column guards and undercharged precision.

The separate reviewer did not use the author's checker as independent evidence. A new Gaussian-rational interpreter checks 600 literal words across all four pivots; noncommutative expression trees check 1,214 cache-lineage records. Wrong-sign and stale-cache mutations fail. A positive-coefficient polynomial certificate bounds the unbounded schedule count. Universal conclusions rest on the written inequalities, not extrapolation from these finite cases.

Six frozen executable fixtures are authenticated by Git blob and SHA256 pins. Source proofs, read hashes, reviews and receipts are retained. Remote head 13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5 has exactly the tested local tree: 30 added files, zero deletions. Committed bytes and modes passed at that head. Strict source-history preflight was not claimed from the shallow checkout. Hosted CI success is not claimed; the unchanged base's #6030/#7000 documentation mismatch stopped #8091 before package selection.

### Scope, overlap and credit

Canonical base: e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Principal source: Ali Romman's #7849 at 3615fd982f2f4dc7172bef6f0dc9a4f77d5ab6dd. Task uniform-transfer-audit is refined to this production numerical implication. The complete rational compiler estimates, certified unit-phase service, exact native H on sufficiently widened private grids, and outer CRT/recovery contracts remain explicit premises.

#7981 changes chronology and the intermediate target, and has an asymptotically smaller selector. **This package is not an improvement over that successor.** It sharpens the original same-chronology contract and reusable local root/interval estimates, subject to a new applicability check for any changed caller. It does not relabel a known low diagnostic-precision failure as a production failure.

Open next steps are the all-size private-grid and owned-arena interface, and independent certification of the inherited full compiler estimates. No production-sized transform, full rounded multiplier, complete tape tariff, selected-certificate change or kernel proof is claimed.

Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate task-agent author/reviewer roles. Credit Ali Romman for #7849 and its integration, Jose Manuel (jmbarrancoml) for the retained full rational compiler, Vlado Vojdanovski for displacement/tensor compilation, Chafik Boukhalfa for certified phases, Cinna Davis and the retained native/recovery contributors. Source notices and Apache-2.0 attribution are preserved. This is model-assisted review, not independent human peer review.

---

## Reviewed complete-gate cuts in the retained rational compiler — 2026-11-23

The consolidated `compiler-cuts/` appendix is published at head `e040fedfd8fcc51480d2468f3fa07562c8bacbf0`, tree `fc5a918a95e2d853afbd99227d6ae17f7b28c129`. The new written argument is bound to eighteen retained source files and a separate reviewer; the original direct-circulant proof is unchanged.

The actual compiler alphabet consists of two same-direction shear matchings with bank-unitary operations. A cut between complete gates leaves a partial matching of the same direction, so the four-way forward/inverse and prefix/suffix norm envelopes survive those cuts. Under the stated conditioning and phase/error premises, the full envelope is `K = 2 L0 B H`, with `B = 256 N^3 (lambda Q)^12`, and complete-gate intervals have the `K^2` bound. Both `lambda >= 1` and `Q >= 1` are needed separately: the product condition alone is false, as the scalar case `lambda=1/1024`, `Q=1024` has inverse norm 1024, exceeding 256.

This closes a source-bound complete-gate interpolation step. It does not prove adjacent measured cuts have no loss, cover incomplete coordinate writes, price physical scratch, or justify changed recursive services. Rank, conditioning, certified phases, accumulated error and the remaining physical/analytic contracts remain explicit. The earlier conditioned-interpolation result #5940 and rounded-event/singular-swap analysis #5240 are credited rather than claimed as new discoveries.

The full seven-command registered replay passed, followed by the committed-byte/mode gate on all 62 package files. The independent reviewer runs in normal and optimized Python. A final receipt-integrity repair restores the frozen review evidence and sends timing-bearing reruns to temporary files; all receipt hash bindings now match. That repair changes output locations and provenance only, not the mathematical argument. The package remains a conditional sharpening of the original #7849 chronology, with no new κ, canonical assumption removal, production-sized execution or claim of hosted CI acceptance.


## Consolidated follow-up: relative compiler intervals and sharper sufficient precision

Head `ea0274f8e6b6add282a63c11c5b8c4420ed3bc7e` has tree `c09b52f711358be141d4403f449c57dd89fb68b3`, identical to the locally tested reconciled tree. It is a direct child of `e040fedfd8fcc51480d2468f3fa07562c8bacbf0` and preserves all 32 incoming `compiler-cuts/` files byte-for-byte. The delta adds 48 files, changes four package metadata/documentation files, and deletes none. The combined package has 110 files.

[Relative-interval integration and review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ea0274f8e6b6add282a63c11c5b8c4420ed3bc7e/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/compiler-intervals/INTEGRATION.md) · [Sharper selector and independent review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ea0274f8e6b6add282a63c11c5b8c4420ed3bc7e/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/spectral-downset/README.md) · [Compatibility review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ea0274f8e6b6add282a63c11c5b8c4420ed3bc7e/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/reconciliation/COMPATIBILITY-REVIEW.md)

### Added mathematical result

The preserved complete-gate supplement provides its four-way envelope and conservative `K_Full^2` interval bound. The separately frozen `compiler-intervals/` proof retains overlapping complete-gate context and adds a relative bound for two nested completed source downsets. Choosing one legal common linearization lets the shared normalized perturbation prefix cancel, without commuting overlapping operations. The stored interval and its actual inverse are bounded by `B^2 H^2/(1-theta)<=4B^2 H^2/3<2B^2 H^2` for `theta<=1/4`, improving `4L0^2 B^2 H^2`. Matching subsets, interleaved siblings and zero-duration atoms are included. Individual `lambda>=1` and `Q>=1` premises are retained; partially overwritten scratch maps remain outside scope.

For the actual rounded, identity-padded root, the sharper analysis supplies spectral norm below two and leading inverse norm at most `4t`. The credited block-solve theorem gives `B_new=2^7 t^3`. The literal `Full.shear` child preparation still receives its original component envelope and rank: `be<=32t^2`, rank at most `5t`, hence `H<=2^23 t^7`. Spectral bounds are never substituted into the component admission or allocation guards. The resulting prefix/suffix cap is `K<=2^33 t^11`, and interval cap `G<=2^61 t^20`.

The consumer proof propagates these through all sixteen H factors, pivot and ordinary factors, routing, both root passes, exterior diagonals, padded-coordinate norm conversion, partial H packs, coefficient synthesis, cache carries and the computed-state bootstrap. For `L=sum ell_i`, `d>=1`, `p>=1`, let

`J=20000(d+1)(max ell_i+2)^6`, `C=4J(d+1)^2+d+1`.

The supplementary sufficient selector is

`P=4p+277L+3011d+(L mod 2)+bit_length(C)`.

It retains the unchanged `P+8` coefficient target and proves raw coordinate error strictly below `2^(-4p)` on complete padded represented inputs of modulus at most one half. The retained public-grid/CRT/no-wrap interfaces are still required for exact integer recovery. The saving from this PR's original selector is exactly `1084L+1735d` bits. At `p=72`, padded widths `(4,5)`, the original source uses 688,620 bits, this PR's original selector 22,068, and this supplement 8,842. These are sufficient bit counts, not optimality or measured speed/storage claims. At fixed external precision the source allocation and word remain unchanged; a changed precision regenerates coefficients through the same original rules.

### Reproduction, scope and credit

All eight registered commands passed on the reconciled package, followed by the 110-file committed-byte/mode gate. Disposable replay wrappers retain the original programs and flags and compare actual newly generated outputs, excluding only elapsed `seconds` where present. All frozen proofs, scientific APIs, source copies and earlier receipts remain unchanged. Added independent evidence covers 149 primitive intervals, 475 nested downset pairs, 1,404 cut intervals, 113 selector inputs, 254 symbolic cache records and 762 rational complex records, including 507 zero-factor records. Normal and optimized independent checks pass. Wrong inverse/order, stale carry, component/spectral conflation and leading-inverse controls are rejected.

The accepted interval proof is `e942012e66adc2d696cde3fedd6ae9c73df98e77a71b16e5004f5a74ccdfaa07`; the selector proof is `0501a6a9a5f467fff4c998606965babc8157e74d98cf33b93f71fb10674d57bb`. The caller remains #7849 at `3615fd982f2f4dc7172bef6f0dc9a4f77d5ab6dd`. #7981 changes chronology and raw target; no improvement over that changed successor is claimed.

Credit Ali Romman for the consumer/recovery integration, Jose Manuel and Vlado Vojdanovski for compiler construction, Chafik Boukhalfa for certified phases, Nick Petalas for #4852 and #5940, Brian/JoyboyBrian for #4755/#4976/#4977, and Armin Pourshafeie / apoursh for #5240. The canonical `integer-rounded-gate` package already constructs a supplied-coefficient arithmetic kernel with `W=B+4C+2`; its exact README pin is included for overlap. Actual caller binding, simultaneous live words, coefficient delivery, cleanup and complete instruction/tape cost remain separate. No new κ, complete foundational discharge, complete storage theorem or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate model-assisted review.


## Accepted supplied dyadic arithmetic supplement

Published head `8559a122f55614163c037b3c20a21f449a0531f6` has full tree `05084a98863808d388706d69775e8dbbff2ba3db`, exactly matching the locally verified tree. This sequential addition preserves the preceding compiler, interval and precision proofs and adds [integration and source boundaries](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8559a122f55614163c037b3c20a21f449a0531f6/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/grid-arithmetic/INTEGRATION.md), the [universal proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8559a122f55614163c037b3c20a21f449a0531f6/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/grid-arithmetic/PROOF.md), and its [separate accepted review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8559a122f55614163c037b3c20a21f449a0531f6/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/grid-arithmetic/review/REVIEW.md).

The new common-denominator specialization binds to the actual external `Grid.multiply` calls. If its four supplied numerators fit signed B bits with B>=2 and 1<=P<=B, four shift/add products and the caller's signed rounding shift fit W=2B+1 bits. A fixed seven-register schedule keeps both outputs and all inputs live within 4B+7W data bits plus logarithmic controls. Under the already accepted spectral-downset theorem, B=P+max(A,E)+3 covers actual table entries, suffix caches and represented data.

The cost is explicitly quadratic: at most (d+1)T multiplication calls per literal diagonal scan, hence O(J(d+1)T B^2) local arithmetic work over J stages. This does not establish the accelerated native tariff or reprice the multiplier recurrence. Coefficient preparation, global movement and ownership, native-H private storage, and reversible cleanup remain retained. Scratch zeroing means ordinary destructive overwrite.

The source bindings preserve the distinct tie rules: `Grid.word` converts coefficient ties to even, while multiplication rounds output ties toward positive infinity. An actual emitted Full.shear gate supplies an exact small-grid counterexample to replacing its external sixteen-H chronology with one once-rounded original gate. Nick Petalas's prior general rational-row kernel and all its diagnostic guards remain byte-identical; the separate new implementation has an all-width proof. At the admissible explicit constructor geometry sides=(2,), digit_bits=5, the sufficient P=3438 already makes `operand(1)` need 3433 signed input bits, outside that predecessor diagnostic's B<=2048 cap. The claim is about a legal explicit constructor call; it does not assert that the uniform geometry selector chooses this instance.

The extracted Grid fixture supplies `operator.mul` as an exact-integer helper. It does not execute or price the retained `word_product` backend. The new fixed-register program is separately proved and charged as above.

**Verification.** The author replay checked 20,336 exact arithmetic cases, 486 unchanged-predecessor scalar bindings, 90 actual Full gate events and 320 literal odometer calls, including 144 zero-factor calls. Separate review checked 39,220 cases, including 18,716 halfway components and 8,628 zero-multiplier cases, 1,020 literal odometer calls, 28 parameter/API bindings, and four rounding/sign mutants. Both author and independent receipts agree byte-for-byte between normal and optimized Python. All eight registered commands pass; the eighth preserves its entire previous replay and appends all four new arithmetic modes. The final manifest's eight timeout caps sum to 1200 seconds.

Run the unchanged package commands from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-circulant-production-precision
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-circulant-production-precision --check-modes
```

**Preservation.** This is an additive change on remote parent `ea0274f8e6b6add282a63c11c5b8c4420ed3bc7e`, base tree `c09b52f711358be141d4403f449c57dd89fb68b3`. It adds 39 files and extends only the parent README, TASK and VERIFY metadata. The other 107 existing package files, including every prior scientific proof, source, API and review, are byte-identical. All 149 final package files pass the exact Git-blob-byte and file-mode gate. The accepted arithmetic proof is SHA256 `05e85b54fd4b8f834f1790ff18ca53f5cd05aaf58e316aef4ba72aabe2b7fa9a`; the new program is `cce97fcc515e3240224cada0a25c666fbac13454135b4fd71589f30bf67b3184`.

The selected five assumptions and κ remain unchanged. Prior credits, including Nick Petalas, Armin Pourshafeie, Jose Manuel, Ali Romman and the earlier compiler/numerical contributors, remain explicit. ## Reviewed exact native output-grid interface

The coherent follow-up at head **780e96d8c149690df0f06661e2b9f94eb91737fe** adds the sibling package [direct-native-grid-interface](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/780e96d8c149690df0f06661e2b9f94eb91737fe/research/direct-native-grid-interface). Its full tree is **72218d1b24decb4543a96ecdac1762efaf0b4b2b**, equal to the locally tested tree. All 26 changed files are additions within that new package; every prior file in this PR remains byte-identical.

### New implication and why it matters

For each actual raw h-bit Hadamard call on the complete P-grid array with radius at most 2^E, set R=E+1 and request native output precision **Q=P+R+h**. The exact entrance left shift is h bits. Under the retained normalized native service contract, the returned integer numerators already are the raw-H output on the original P-grid: final truncation loses nothing, and no second return shift is applied. A signed basis witness is lost at Q-1, proving sharpness for this fixed scaling and return contract. Actual strides, spectators, padded dirty holes and absolute C/S/b phases are included.

The separate review found a missing explanation for terminal b^h normalization. The repaired proof credits the existing compiled-root divisibility/parity lemma and implements the completed-endpoint macro. Conditional on the retained C-interior common-grid premise, temporary width is P+E+3h+31. Production gives Q<=4807p and temporary width<=4839p, hence at most 13 extra bits in the logarithmic service parameter. Actual direct-circulant geometry establishes eventual scale compatibility; unspecified reservoir constants remain inherited.

[Universal proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/780e96d8c149690df0f06661e2b9f94eb91737fe/research/direct-native-grid-interface/PROOF.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/780e96d8c149690df0f06661e2b9f94eb91737fe/research/direct-native-grid-interface/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md) · [Integration](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/780e96d8c149690df0f06661e2b9f94eb91737fe/research/direct-native-grid-interface/INTEGRATION.md).

### Reproduction and evidence

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-native-grid-interface
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-native-grid-interface --check-modes
```

Both registered commands passed, with normal and optimized child runs using fresh private bytecode-cache directories. Newly generated JSON matches frozen receipts without rewriting them. Author regression covers 1,829 adapter cases, 132,460 macro components, 180 sharp witnesses, 107 pack cases, 84 selectors and 12 controls. Separate reviewer code imports no author adapter/checker: dense-sign and Gaussian-rational methods check 360 complete fields / 32,004 components, 5,460 phase entries, 5,460 terminal-normalization entries, 240 signed sharpness witnesses and 430 parameter enclosures. Missing normalization, insufficient output precision, nonendpoint divisor/parity and altered-source controls fail. All eight retained sources were independently byte-compared with their exact Git commit/path pins. Committed bytes and executable modes pass for the package plus its selected-record input.

This proves the caller/output-format implication, **not** a native implementation, stock/geometry admission, joined historical arena backing or full movement tariff. One serial conversion window is charged separately from native banks. All five canonical assumptions and selected kappa=0.00363005817 remain unchanged. No new kappa or hosted CI acceptance is claimed. Credit remains with Ali Romman's #7849, earlier #8093 proofs, retained normalized-H/common-grid work and compiled-root-clifford-precision. ## Reviewed caller and native-window lifetime join

The follow-up at head `1c45d4f74f40d60339190184cf564027ddeb42dd`, tree `9d9844eff6c241270e0e241bb5089689956a6d50`, adds 28 files in `research/direct-native-lifetime-join` and preserves every earlier file. It joins the preceding requested-grid theorem to the actual #7849 convolution caller.

The literal source reference-retention schedule admits **seven complete outer field slots**. The three transforms retain 3, 4 and 6 fields at their native calls; eight new fields are constructed, seven retire, and the result survives with the two original operands. Pending destinations count before their input is consumed. All padded records and holes are included. Seven is a sufficient source-preserving schedule, not an optimal slot-count lower bound.

One complete reusable conversion window, with W*=P+E+3h*+31, composes with the native grid adapter. Writing F_B=2T(B+2)+2 and F_star=2T(W*+2)+2, the historical allowance is `7F_B+F_star+sum_t A_t+M+O(d B_c+B_work+log(T+1))`. Each A_t is the maximum of its initial native tape reservation and all legal call extents. This sum cannot be replaced by a simultaneous live peak. Wrapper construction, installation, complete erasure and returns cost O(H T W*+TB), in addition to original arithmetic, coefficients and native work.

Contract N requires an in-window endpoint, restoration of borrowed values and heads, full private retirement, no escaping mutable alias, and a legal capacity-independent trace. Every auxiliary owner backing must be charged among the displayed roles, M or A_t. Thus this gives O(Tp) only when the stated width, persistent-control and native-extent premises are independently supplied; it does not prove those premises. A surviving outer result also prevents reuse across later public calls without paid transfer/retirement. Later recovery arrays and the growing final integer remain excluded.

The independent review imports no author lifetime implementation or checker. It extracts the two authenticated original methods and uses a separate weak-reference census, registering pending allocations before consuming inputs. Fifteen cases verify the source owner counts, unchanged roots and return boundary; omitted caller roots, aliased inputs and altered source bytes are detected. The separate author arithmetic/lifetime replay covers 22 cases, 528 native calls, 483,696 complete record visits and ten controls, through padded fields of size 2,048. Both registered suites pass in normal and optimized Python with fresh caches; the 29-file committed-byte/mode gate and all seven exact commit:path source comparisons pass. Finite checks corroborate the written source-level argument.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-native-lifetime-join
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-native-lifetime-join --check-modes
```

Expected markers include `PASS_NATIVE_LIFETIME_AUTHOR_NORMAL_OPTIMIZED_FRESH_CACHE`, `PASS_NATIVE_LIFETIME_INDEPENDENT_NORMAL_OPTIMIZED_FRESH_CACHE` and the registered-package/committed-byte passes. The author normalized callback is a sequential oracle, not a native speed claim. Lease guards reject stale API access but do not prove arbitrary native code has no hidden captures.

All five canonical assumptions and selected κ remain unchanged. No full native implementation, multiplier-space theorem or hosted-CI acceptance is claimed.
